card.name: Inside thio- and thyro- word starts
card.fires_on: The first pieces of long words that begin with th, especially thio- (thiopental, thioguanine) and thyro- (anti-thyroid, thyroxine). It also fires inside German words like -tang and -thromboglobulin.

modes.label: thio- and thyro- drug terms
modes.description: Start of drug or hormone words such as thiopental, thioguanine, thyroid, thyroxine.
